resource_scope: Entry files and their direct local Markdown references on both hosts; not a transitive install closure.

skills.name: dk-pr-iter
skills.inputs: PR, actor identities, personal accounts, explicit route
skills.outputs: Selected fix/review invocation and identity evidence
skills.permissions: Read; downstream writes need their own grants
skills.completion: Immutable author identity established and selected route completed
skills.intentional_differences: Host and provider remain distinct; unknown identity blocks routing

skills.name: dk-pr-fix
skills.inputs: PR pins, original instructions, selected plan and retained budgets
skills.outputs: Tested fixes, independent findings, finalizer evidence, completion and readiness
skills.permissions: Local edits only when authorized; each remote effect separately scoped
skills.completion: Selected tasks accepted, required replies settled before review, current readiness separately assessed
skills.intentional_differences: Use YAML orchestration and Python boundaries rather than upstream controller

skills.name: dk-pr-review
skills.inputs: Other-author PR pins, original constraints, selected reviewers
skills.outputs: Discovery, independent verification, dispositions and optional publication
skills.permissions: Read; finding publication, fork CI approval, PR approval and merge distinct
skills.completion: Current selected coverage and verification accepted; omissions remain explicit
skills.intentional_differences: Real observed coordinator/children required; private provisional analysis is not readiness

skills.name: dk-repo-onboard
skills.inputs: Repository, instruction-source choice, settings and preferences
skills.outputs: Complete source/rule/settings inventory with conflicts and gaps
skills.permissions: Read only; no saved default choice or workflow execution
skills.dependencies: Shared source discovery and configuration readers
skills.completion: Every discovered source inspected or explicitly incomplete
skills.intentional_differences: No automatic import or onboarding prerequisite for ordinary reads

skills.name: dk-config
skills.inputs: Exact ask, relevant scope, current settings and original context
skills.outputs: Configuration explanation or admitted revision and readback
skills.permissions: Local configuration writes only after structural and native semantic admission
skills.dependencies: Shared configuration agent and durable request contract
skills.completion: Questions settled, exact revision applied and verified; uncertainty reconciled
skills.intentional_differences: Fresh cf-workflows namespace; no legacy settings conversion

skills.name: dk-preferences
skills.inputs: Exact instructions, include/exclude selectors, conditions and application modes
skills.outputs: Scoped records or removals with provenance and readback
skills.permissions: Read; local saves need admitted request and revision
skills.completion: Overlaps reconciled without invented precedence; atomic exact change read back
skills.intentional_differences: Do not import upstream preference catalog

skills.name: dk-issue-alternatives
skills.inputs: Issue requirements, constraints, shared assessment, optional PR candidate
skills.outputs: Whole-problem comparisons and sourced selection
skills.permissions: Private analysis; selection grants no edits or publication
skills.dependencies: Shared rubric, assessment and decision reconciliation
skills.completion: Feasible options evaluated at common target; unresolved selections remain pending
skills.intentional_differences: No fake PR identity for issue-only work

skills.name: dk-pr-alternatives
skills.inputs: Pinned branch, inherited architecture, rubric and agreements
skills.outputs: Decision inventory, questionable-decision comparisons and selection
skills.permissions: Read-only private analysis
skills.completion: Inherited/introduced/changed decisions covered; selected interactions checked
skills.intentional_differences: Once-per-PR boundary; guidance changes do not authorize fresh comparisons

skills.name: dk-alternatives-review
skills.inputs: Whole-problem ask or retained legacy assignment identity
skills.outputs: Delegated comparison or recovered original assignment result
skills.permissions: Private analysis; no new write permission
skills.completion: Correct target capability executed; legacy keys and original evidence retained
skills.intentional_differences: Compatibility entry is explicit, never counted as implementation of another row

skills.name: dk-pr-review-alternatives
skills.inputs: Direct user request identity, exact instruction, PR pins
skills.outputs: Fresh requested architecture review with original request retained
skills.permissions: Private read-only alternatives only
skills.completion: Requested comparisons complete; no ordinary-review or readiness claim
skills.intentional_differences: Changed fingerprints or downstream calls do not fabricate a new manual request

skills.name: dk-plain-english
skills.inputs: Changed prose, full diff/delta, governing meaning and options
skills.outputs: Edits or sourced no-op, validation and ambiguities
skills.permissions: Authorized local prose edits; commits and publication separate
skills.dependencies: Shared prose cleanup and native task completion
skills.completion: Meaning and protected syntax preserved; requested pass completed
skills.intentional_differences: Minimal adjacent edits only; no unrelated prose rewrite

skills.name: dk-asd-ste100
skills.inputs: Changed prose, authoritative STE references when available
skills.outputs: Best-effort edits, validation and exact reference-verification limits
skills.permissions: Authorized local prose edits; commits and publication separate
skills.dependencies: Shared prose cleanup; official ASD-STE sources
skills.completion: Meaning checked; unavailable rule/dictionary verification explicitly recorded
skills.intentional_differences: Never claim full STE compliance from best-effort editing

skills.name: dk-code-simplify
skills.inputs: Pinned PR changes, governing evidence and scope/priority
skills.outputs: Bounded behavior-preserving recommendations, deferred observations
skills.permissions: Read only; no edits, formatters, commits or publication
skills.dependencies: Native review evidence and independent coordinator verification
skills.completion: Actionable recommendations anchored with concrete benefit and preservation evidence
skills.intentional_differences: No mandatory child passes; does not replace ordinary review coverage

skills.name: dk-pr-reviewers-run
skills.inputs: Pinned inputs, selected installed reviewers, required/optional flags
skills.outputs: Original reviewer results, coverage, native identities and observations
skills.permissions: Read-only review; no publication permission
skills.dependencies: Native capability preflight; selected third-party lifecycle/pass contracts
skills.completion: Every required actual pass and deeper look evidenced; optional gaps explicit
skills.intentional_differences: No default reviewer; report-only substitutes cannot establish execution

skills.name: dk-pr-approvers
skills.inputs: Canonical PR, final published head, publisher override and evidence
skills.outputs: Eligible user/team recipients with reasons or exact empty override
skills.permissions: Read only; no request-review publication
skills.dependencies: Publisher options; complete paginated GitHub and CODEOWNERS evidence
skills.completion: Selection complete for unchanged head, or explicit blockers
skills.intentional_differences: Empty override disables discovery; native reviewers are separate

skills.name: dk-pr-feedback-read
skills.inputs: Canonical PR/head and complete comments/reviews/threads
skills.outputs: Stable complete feedback and separately actionable requests
skills.permissions: Read only
skills.completion: All pages and thread context captured; head and snapshot stable
skills.intentional_differences: Unanswered discussion alone does not establish author response obligation

skills.name: dk-pr-feedback-address
skills.inputs: Complete feedback, current code, agreements and implementation preferences
skills.outputs: Tested fixes, per-request dispositions and remaining response obligations
skills.permissions: Authorized local edits; push, reply and resolution separate
skills.dependencies: dk-pr-feedback-read; shared response obligations and decision reconciliation
skills.completion: Every assigned request verified/disposed with evidence and checklist
skills.intentional_differences: Declining a code change does not erase a concrete author response obligation

skills.name: dk-pr-feedback-reply
skills.inputs: Original source/thread, current code/tests, response decisions and prompt
skills.outputs: Bundled attributed answers, publication receipts and optional resolution
skills.permissions: Scoped reply and thread-resolution grants separately required
skills.completion: Applicable replies verified; resolve only fully answered actual inline threads
skills.intentional_differences: Repository agent guidance excluded from replies under host priority; no diagnostic replies

skills.name: dk-pr-review-post
skills.inputs: Original results, independent verification, current head/diff and exact payload
skills.outputs: Verified inline findings and body-only metadata findings with receipts
skills.permissions: Finding publication scoped separately from PR approval
skills.completion: Anchors verified or real unanchorable findings preserved in body; uncertainty reconciled
skills.intentional_differences: Body-only findings survive summaries disabled; no fabricated anchors

skills.name: dk-pr-description
skills.inputs: Diff, templates, current title/body, agreed scope and Decisions
skills.outputs: Reviewed title/body draft or verified authorized update
skills.permissions: Draft read-only; explicit scoped description edit
skills.completion: Enabled fields match final scope; disabled fields and unrelated sections preserved
skills.intentional_differences: Private comparisons/scores never copied into public description

skills.name: dk-pr-decisions
skills.inputs: Sourced agreements, complete user revisions, PR evidence and section setting
skills.outputs: Reconciled structured decisions, open questions and bounded public section
skills.permissions: Analysis read-only; section update separately authorized
skills.completion: Sources verified; governing conflicts settled before dependent edits
skills.intentional_differences: Historical Decisions cannot silently restore revised/excluded agreements

skills.name: dk-commit-split
skills.inputs: All PR commits, effective policy, ownership, exact leases and original constraints
skills.outputs: Assessed boundaries/messages or safely rewritten series and recovery refs
skills.permissions: Local rewrite authorization; push requires independent grant and exact lease
skills.completion: Every commit assessed; final tree and authorship preserved; bounded passes
skills.intentional_differences: Policy provider returns instructions only; max five cleanup passes

skills.name: dk-pr-split
skills.inputs: PR size/scope policies, ownership, recovery refs and leases
skills.outputs: Supported keep/split assessment or verified split PRs
skills.permissions: Local move/rewrite and remote operations independently authorized
skills.completion: Boundaries justified; original final scope accounted for with tested recovery
skills.intentional_differences: No size-only excuse to discard required work

skills.name: dk-pr-publish
skills.inputs: Concrete target/actor/head, exact payload, scoped grant and current evidence
skills.outputs: Intent, dispatch/reconciliation receipt or explicit blocker
skills.permissions: Remote writes default off; every action separately scoped
skills.dependencies: Shared exact-intent journal; live review, CI and repository gates
skills.completion: Exact effect verified or conclusive not_applied; unknown remains pending
skills.intentional_differences: Fork CI, findings, APPROVE and merge are separate; pending review requests hold merge

skills.name: dk-ci-approve
skills.inputs: Current incoming-review evidence, exact foreign PR/head/target and eligible run attempts
skills.outputs: One verified approval operation per eligible run/attempt or sourced no-op
skills.permissions: Fork workflow execution approval only; never deployment, PR approval or merge
skills.completion: Clean complete current review, reconciled effects and unchanged eligibility
skills.intentional_differences: Never automatically invoked by fix workflow

skills.name: dk-ci
skills.inputs: Canonical PR, exact head, timeout/deadline and repair/rerun allowances
skills.outputs: Current check outcomes, accepted issue-backed flakes/exceptions or blocker
skills.permissions: Read by default; bounded repair/rerun uses explicit permissions
skills.completion: Only current success/known flakes/accepted exceptions satisfy CI; head change invalidates
skills.intentional_differences: Fresh session preserves deadline; retry dispatch is not success

skills.name: dk-ci-flakes
skills.inputs: Repository, requested scan scope/limits or saved failed-test identity
skills.outputs: Named test observations, linked open-issue evidence and limits/gaps
skills.permissions: Read only; issue creation/rerun separately authorized
skills.dependencies: Shared CI registry and complete relevant logs/issue reads
skills.completion: Each accepted flake has exact test/job/attempt and current open-issue proof
skills.intentional_differences: Ordinary PR failure does not request repository-wide history scan

skills.name: dk-commit-message
skills.inputs: Actual staged/unstaged scope, repository conventions, policy and authorship
skills.outputs: Reviewed message with scope, policy and sources
skills.permissions: Draft read-only; commit only when requested
skills.dependencies: Shared local commit preparation and commit policy
skills.completion: Message describes actual selected change and preserves original constraints
skills.intentional_differences: Message-only invocation never changes Git

skills.name: dk-issue
skills.inputs: Exact ask, verified facts, repository template, labels and assignees
skills.outputs: Reviewed draft or verified issue creation/update with receipt
skills.permissions: Draft read-only; issue write separately authorized
skills.dependencies: Shared exact-intent publication and repository conventions
skills.completion: Target metadata verified; exact write reconciled before retry
skills.intentional_differences: A PR workflow alone does not authorize issue creation
